description: Retrieve a complete IPO company profile — deal terms, pricing range, expected market cap, SEC registration and prospectus details, offering structure, lifecycle timeline, and IBKR indicative borrow fee rate when available. When available, includes AI-generated research with valuation models, competitor benchmarking, underwriter ratings, board analysis, and risk factors. Provide exactly one of companyId, symbol, or cik. PREMIUM: paid per call over x402 (USDC on Base); an unpaid call returns the payment terms, and a not-found is never charged. Same data and price as the HTTP endpoint /api/agent/ipo/{id} or /api/agent/ipo/by-symbol/{symbol}.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, with or without leading zeros, e.g. 1876042 or 0001876042.

companyId.description: IPOSignal company id (24-character hex), as returned by other IPOSignal responses.

symbol.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. CRCL. Case-insensitive. Tickers get reassigned, so a response may carry a symbolNote.

name: get_ipo_snapshot

asOfDate.description: Date the rate was quoted, YYYY-MM-DD.

feeRate.description: Annual borrow fee in percent, IBKR's unit: 0.25 means 0.25% a year, 35 means 35% a year.

borrowFee.description: Latest indicative cost of borrowing the shares to sell short, from Interactive Brokers. Present once the stock trades and IBKR quotes it.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key: the registrant's permanent SEC identifier, as a 10-digit string with leading zeros, e.g. 0001876042.

company.description: Registrant name as filed with the SEC, e.g. Circle Internet Group, Inc.

acceptedDate.description: Time EDGAR accepted the filing, ISO 8601.

accessionNumber.description: SEC accession number, the filing's unique id, e.g. 0001193125-25-132755.

documentUrl.description: The filing's main document on sec.gov, when we resolved it.

formType.description: SEC form type, e.g. S-1, S-1/A, 424B4, EFFECT, RW, 25-NSE.

indexUrl.description: The filing's folder on sec.gov, listing every document in it.

filings.description: The company's SEC filings we track (registration statements, amendments, 424B prospectuses, delisting notices), oldest first.

articles.description: Articles as Freedom24 publishes them: title, provider, date, URL and text.

lastSyncedAt.description: When we last fetched Freedom24's list for the company, ISO 8601.

freedom24News.description: News articles about the deal from Freedom24, when it covers the company.

date.description: First trading day, YYYY-MM-DD. For a deal that has not listed, the scheduled date.

dateSource.description: Where date comes from: observed-trading (a trade we observed on that day) or scheduled (an exchange calendar).

exchange.description: Listing exchange: NASDAQ, NYSE, NYSEAMER (NYSE American) or OTC. Other venues verbatim.

issuer.description: Issuer line when it differs from company. Currently never set.

marketCap.description: What the company was worth at the offer, USD: economic shares outstanding right after the offering × offer price. Not the amount raised (see offerSize).

marketCapSource.description: Where marketCap comes from: sec (share count from the filing), qra-prospectus (the final prospectus), scoop (IPOScoop), override (checked by hand). Null when unknown.

offerPrice.description: Final offer price, USD per share. Null until the deal has priced.

offerSize.description: Gross proceeds, USD: shares offered × offer price. What the deal raised, not what the company is worth.

priceRange.description: The filed price range as text, low to high, USD per share, e.g. $16.00-$18.00. Null once the final price is known.

shares.description: Shares offered in the deal. Not shares outstanding.

date.description: Date the status took effect, YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: filed, expected, prelisting, priced, trading, postponed, withdrawn, halted, halt_resumed, delisted or acquired.

lifecycleEvents.description: The deal's dated status history, oldest first.

acceptedDate.description: Time EDGAR accepted the filing, ISO 8601.

effectivenessDate.description: Date the SEC declared the statement effective, YYYY-MM-DD. Currently always null: no source we read carries it.

filingDate.description: Date the statement was filed, YYYY-MM-DD.

form.description: SEC form type: S-1, S-1/A, F-1, F-1/A, S-11 or S-11/A.

status.description: Registration status. Currently always null: no source we read carries it.

url.description: The statement's main document on sec.gov.

registration.description: The registration statement the deal was sold on: the latest S-1, F-1 or S-11 (or amendment) filed on or before the listing date.

analystSector.description: Sector we classify the company in.

analystSubsector.description: Subsector we classify the company in.

background.description: Short background, when the prospectus gives one.

role.description: Role on the board, e.g. Chair, Independent Director.

interestLevel.description: Our read of how much attention the deal draws: High, Medium or Low.

isInvestmentVehicle.description: True for a trust, fund, ETF or SPAC rather than an operating company.

keyRisks.description: The main risks, one sentence each.

summary.description: Summary of the company and the deal.

useOfProceeds.description: What the company says it will do with the money raised.

research.description: Research written by our AI pipeline from the prospectus: summary, competitors, board, risks and valuation work. Text, not filed figures: check a number against the filing before relying on it. Absent until the pipeline has run for the deal.

category.description: SEC filer category, e.g. Non-accelerated filer, Emerging growth company.

description.description: Industry from the company's SIC code, e.g. Services-Prepackaged Software.

sec.description: How the SEC classifies the company.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol the company trades under now, upper case, e.g. CRCL.

currentHolderCik.description: CIK of the company that holds the ticker today, when known.

currentHolderName.description: Name of the company that holds the ticker today, when known.

servedCik.description: CIK of the company whose record this response holds.

symbolNote.description: Present only when the ticker you asked for has belonged to more than one company and the record served is not the current holder's. Absent on an ordinary lookup.

updatedAt.description: When any part of this record last changed, ISO 8601.

venue.description: Listing exchange: NASDAQ, NYSE, NYSEAMER (NYSE American) or OTC. Other venues verbatim.

title: IPO snapshot (premium)
